verdict.rationale: Granola documents an official MCP server, 'Granola MCP', for connecting Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools to meeting notes, and a probe confirms the MCP page exists. Once connected, agents can search notes, find topics from past meetings and query transcripts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP connection, and documented detail on setup, authentication and the exposed tool list.
